verdict.rationale: The official docs state that Crawl4AI parses repeated patterns with CSS or XPath extraction. The GitHub README adds that custom schemas can be defined to extract structured JSON from repetitive patterns, which together cover selector-based field extraction. The evidence consists of short feature-list mentions only: missing for 10: detailed docs or examples of the field-level selector schema syntax (e.g., per-field attribute/text rules), and independent or hands-on confirmation that CSS/XPath extraction works as described.
